sentences.en: Smartphones would have seemed like science fiction ten years ago.
sentences.zh: 智能手机十年前似乎还只是科幻小说中的东西。

sentences.en: Some know that science fantasy is different from science fiction.
sentences.zh: 有些人知道科学幻想与科学小说是不同的。

sentences.en: Science fact, you might know, is different from science fiction.
sentences.zh: 你可能知道，科学事实与科学小说是有区别的。

senses.zh: 小说 - 虚构的或想像出的事, 并非完全真实的事 形容词: fictional
